sources.title: Crown Fuzz and Treble Booster | Effects Database
sources.excerpt: Effects Database identifies the Crown Fuzz and Treble Booster as an early version of the Applied Audio Products two-in-one fuzz and high-frequency boost design. The exact Crown-labeled model combined a transistor-based fuzz circuit with an independent treble booster and was part of a family of OEM-branded units. The page describes separate fuzz and treble controls and notes battery operation and mechanical switching.

sources.title: Tone Machines Blog: Applied Fuzz and Treble Booster FT-100
sources.h1: Applied Fuzz and Treble Booster FT-100
sources.excerpt: Tone Machines Blog documents the Applied Fuzz and Treble Booster family and specifically discusses a Crown-labeled example. The article notes distinctive early features such as the large battery-test lamp, the two-function fuzz and treble-boost arrangement, and multiple OEM brandings including Crown. It places examples in the late-1960s production period and distinguishes early and later physical details.
